edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Event Horizon (self-cage) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Primordial Burst scales off missing health — fire it as Sylas dips under half, before Kingslayer's heal drags him back up.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: At half HP one Abduct chain onto you is the whole health bar — back off until his E shows; the stacks will still be there.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Abduct-chaining onto you, healing through your poke with Kingslayer, and Hijacking your own execute R at 6.
